svg.title: RDP: TPKT, X.224 CR, cookie, negotiation
svg.desc: The Connection Request of frame 6 of rdp-x509.pcap, 32 bits per row: the TPKT header (version 3, length 47), the X.224 CR TPDU (length indicator 42, type 0xE0, zero references, class 0), the routing cookie Cookie: mstshash=JOHN-PC ended by CR LF, then the 8-byte RDP_NEG_REQ (type 1, flags 0, length 8, requestedProtocols 0); RdpPdu keeps the TPKT length, the X224Tpdu and a ConnectionRequest payload with the token and the NegotiationRequest.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
